 Ben Shelton has started his journey in the ATP Finals 2026 with a strong step, despite facing tough opposition from Arthur Fils , an opponent who really challenged him and forced the American to showcase his best version. The final result was 6-2 3-6 6-3 in favor of Shelton, who had Juan Carlos Ferrero in his box, already giving encouragement and advice during the match.
 Shelton’s serve is a weapon of mass destruction, especially on the court of the Inalpi Arena in Turin . With unprecedented power and the ability to vary spins and directions, the American unleashed his full potential in that facet of tennis, but he complemented it with a great competitive spirit and good shot selection at crucial moments.
 Locked IN 🔒 Shelton breezes through the first set 6-2 vs Fils #NittoATPFinals https://t.co/Mhwq5825Db
 — Tennis TV (@TennisTV) November 15, 2026 
 Shelton found in his serve the great ally to avoid difficult situations against Fils
 After overwhelming in the first set, he saw his victory endangered by a high level from Fils , who found a way to maximize a slight distraction from Ben while serving. The French player's energy was immense and he seemed to have a good scenario for himself in the third set, but he ran into the most mature version of the current world number 4.
 He had to sweat to evade defeat, getting out of complicated situations with his serve and managing the pressure very well. This victory gives a lot of momentum to Ben Shelton in his quest to reach the semifinals while providing great joy to Juan Carlos Ferrero , who showed his excitement and commitment to this new adventure in the American's coaching bench. He has a strong chance to qualify for the semifinals, but his duel with Zverev could be decisive.
